Hi, I'm **AP**. I'm a data analyst who likes taking messy public data and
turning it into something people can explore. Each project below has an
**interactive dashboard**, a **short presentation** of the findings, and a
**methodology page** covering sources, definitions and limitations.

## Projects

::: {.project-card}
### PATH train ridership, 2012–2026

The Port Authority publishes PATH ridership only as PDF reports, with no API or CSV.
I built a pipeline that extracts 15 years of monthly and hourly data from 27 reports
(over 2,000 pages). It validates the results against the reports' own subtotals and
two government datasets. The analysis covers how ridership collapsed in 2020, how it
has recovered, and how the daily commute changed.
